subject: Request: short trial extension & dev credits for PineBridge integration delay
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@pinebridge.ai>, Lia Gomez <lia@pinebridge.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short trial extension & dev credits for PineBridge integration delay

Hi Samir / Lia,

Thanks again for the detailed run-through this morning. I reviewed the error snippets you sent over and I see the Kafka webhook schema misalignment is blocking your ingestion pipeline — totally understand the sprint impact. Engineering told me their earliest safe ETA to finish the fix and full test cycle is about 7–10 business days, but given QA and customer-side validation they flagged it could stretch into the second week after that.

Given that timeline, PineBridge is at risk of running out of sandbox capacity before the integration completes. To avoid a hard stop on your evaluation, can we approve the following on a short-term basis:

- 2-week trial extension (postponing current trial expiry by 14 days)
- 30,000 free token credits applied to the PineBridge sandbox account (conditional on acceptance of the attached Mutual Action Plan)

I attached an updated MAP that outlines the remaining integration milestones and a short log excerpt with the webhook failure patterns. If 30k looks excessive from your side, tell me a target and we can surface that internally — we're mainly trying to keep your engineers unblocked while this fix lands.

Requesting a decision by end of day next Tuesday so we can process entitlements with billing and ops. If you prefer, we can do a quick 15-min call — I can loop in our Integration Success engineer for a short troubleshooting session.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124

Attachments:
- PineBridge_MAP_v2.pdf (Updated mutual action plan)
- webhook-error-snippets.txt (3 small excerpts)
From: Samir Patel <samir@pinebridge.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lia Gomez <lia@pinebridge.ai>, procurement@pinebridge.ai
Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short trial extension & dev credits for PineBridge integration delay

Neha — thanks for the fast follow and for putting the MAP together. The error samples match what our eng team saw; we pushed a temporary shim this morning that reduces the rate of failures but doesn't solve the root cause.

Engineering is optimistic they can finish the permanent fix and full test pass within 7–10 business days from today. Given that, procurement asked if we can get a 2-week extension and 15k credits to cover token usage while we validate. 30k would be appreciated but we're conscious of setting expectations for our CFO.

If Redwood could consider 15k plus a short office-hours slot with an integration specialist (1–2 hours) that would probably be enough to get us over the hump. Can you confirm if that combination is possible?

Samir Patel
Head of Integrations | PineBridge Analytics
samir@pinebridge.ai
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@pinebridge.ai>, Lia Gomez <lia@pinebridge.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: short trial extension & dev credits for PineBridge integration delay

Team — forwarding PineBridge's reply. They ask for a 2-week extension + 15k credits and are asking for a 1–2 hour office-hours session with an integration specialist. My read: they have a real integration blocker but the timeline (7–10 business days) is reasonable.

Proposal for internal approval:
- Approve 2-week extension (straightforward entitlement change)
- Offer 20k free token credits (split the gap: more than their ask, less than my initial ask)
- Provide a one-hour engineering office-hours session next week (redwood eng/success resource)
- Require signed MAP (attached) and quick PO or procurement acknowledgment before credits are applied

If you approve, I'll send the official extension + credit offer and attach the MAP. Billing will need a signed engagement note before we allocate credits.

Neha
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@pinebridge.ai>, Lia Gomez <lia@pinebridge.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Jul 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: short trial extension & dev credits for PineBridge integration delay

Thanks for the context, Neha. Approved with the minor conditions below.

What we'll grant:
- 14-day trial extension starting on their current expiry date
- 20,000 free token credits applied to PineBridge sandbox account upon receipt of the signed MAP or procurement acknowledgement (procurement email OK for now)
- 60-minute office-hours with our Integration Success engineer (I assigned Prio for the slot; Priyom, can you confirm next-week availability?)

Conditions / Next steps:
1) Neha to send the official extension + credit offer PDF (approved-extension-offer.pdf) to Samir and procurement for signature/acknowledgement.
2) Apply credits only after we receive the signed MAP or an explicit procurement confirmation email (procurement@pinebridge.ai).
3) Priyom to schedule the 60-min office-hours and include an agenda (webhook schema, test vectors, and verification checklist).

Priyom — if you can confirm availability for next Wed/Thu morning PST, we can lock the slot. Neha — once you get procurement confirmation, loop billing to allocate credits.

Ben Carter
Director, Commercial Accounts | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0199

Attachment: approved-extension-offer.pdf (includes credit terms and MAP signature page)
